item.title: Meta brings Pocket, an app that lets you vibe-code and share games, to US users
item.description: Meta is bringing Pocket, its experimental AI-powered app for creating and sharing interactive games, to users across the U.S. after quietly testing it in Brazil.

item.title: Inertia Enterprises finds a way to make its fusion fuel fast
item.description: Fusion power startup Inertia Enterprises reduced the fuel filling process from a week to just a few hours. It's one of 10 hurdles the company must overcome to make a profitable power plant.

item.title: Meta AI’s new Mac app wants you to talk to your apps
item.description: The company said that the dictation feature works across all apps, just like other tools such as Wispr Flow, Superwhisper, and Monologue.

item.title: Binance now lets AI agents trade, but keeping them in check is largely up to users
item.description: Binance's Agent OS works with tools such as ChatGPT, Claude Code, and Cursor.

item.title: Stripe didn’t really buy OpenRouter because of the ‘singularity’
item.description: What does a payments giant want with a startup that routes prompts between different AI models? Stripe says it's because of "the singularity" but it's really for a far more real and powerful reason.

item.title: OpenAI seeks to one-up Anthropic with new customer privacy protections
item.description: A competition is developing between OpenAI and Anthropic over who can provide the best privacy protections for enterprise customer data.

item.title: Cognition CEO denies report that SpaceX tried to acquire the startup
item.description: SpaceX was reportedly in talks to buy AI coding startup Cognition. SpaceX has already acquired Cursor as it races to catch up to rivals like OpenAI and Anthropic in enterprise AI.

item.title: AI was supposed to win people over by now — it hasn’t
item.description: As AI becomes harder to avoid, consumers are growing more wary of the technology — and Silicon Valley is discovering that widespread adoption doesn’t necessarily lead to acceptance.

item.title: Google packs Search and Gemini with new AI study tools
item.description: The launch of the new study features marks Google's latest effort to make Gemini the AI assistant that students turn to when learning and studying, as it continues to compete with companies like OpenAI.

item.title: Researchers say OpenAI revoked their access to limited cyber program
item.description: The idea behind OpenAI's Trusted Access for Cyber program is to give trusted defenders better models so they can report bugs and vulnerabilities to companies, with the aim of getting flaws patched faster.

item.title: Meet the startup helping Wall Street put a price on AI compute
item.description: The AI buildout shows no signs of slowing. And with hundreds of billions of dollars a year going into data centers and GPUs, compute has become the single biggest cost for anyone building AI products. But for all that spending, there still isn’t a straightforward way to put a price on compute — or for firms to hedge their exposure when the price changes.  Silicon Data […]

item.title: TerraPower’s nuclear reactor has a secret weapon for powering AI data centers
item.description: TerraPower's nuclear power plant possesses a strategic advantage over competitors, especially when chasing after data center deals.

item.title: Amazon makes its AI-powered Alexa+ free on Fire TV, no Prime required
item.description: Amazon is making its AI-powered Alexa+ assistant free on all compatible Fire TV devices in the U.S., automatically upgrading users whether or not they subscribe to Prime.

item.title: Calendly throws its hat into meeting note-taker circus
item.description: Calendly is also releasing a meeting scheduling assistant called Callie.

item.title: AI isn’t close to curing cancer. This startup says it knows what it will take.
item.description: It's the data, stupid.

item.title: Relativity Networks raises $22 million to bring a faster kind of fiber to data centers
item.description: Relativity Networks deals in hollow-core fiber, a rarely deployed technology that allows data to be transmitted 30% faster than conventional fiber.

item.title: Cursor capitalizes on GitHub frustration, launches rival hosting platform
item.description: Cursor, known for its AI Code Editor, is launching a new code-hosting platform to rival developers' long preferred favorite, GitHub.

item.title: OpenAI institutes new safeguards after Hugging Face breach
item.description: The new safeguards include more detailed monitoring of models during the development process, as well as greater emphasis on alignment and security during the post-training process.

item.title: Etched’s valuation doubles to $21B in a month
item.description: Jane Street has installed Etched's first shipped AI cluster system, and was so impressed, it led another massive round, the startup says.

item.title: Why Apple’s camera-equipped AirPods may not be the ‘pervert pods’ consumers fear
item.description: Apple’s leaked camera-equipped AirPods might avoid the privacy pitfalls of other AI wearables by preventing users from recording photos and videos.
